questions.question: Analyze the interconnectedness of Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi in Patanjali’s path of yoga.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyze the interconnectedness of dharana , dhyana and samadhi in Patanjali’s path of yoga .
  • Ans
  • a) Dharana
  • holding the minds , focus on one object or point .
  • could be a breath , a candle plane , a mantra or an image .
  • helps in training the mind to avoid distractions.
  • foundation of meditation.
  • b) Dhyana (meditation)
  • deep , interrupted flow of concentration.
  • a meditative state , where awareness is continuous.
  • Brings peace , insights and calmness.
  • c) Samadhi ( enlightenment or bliss)
  • The final stage of spiritual absorption and unity.
  • The ego disappears and one feels oneness within the universe.
  • it is a state of ultimate freedom and realisation.
  • - Interconnectedness
  • - Dharana → Dhyana → Samadhi: Progressive stages of mental refinement
  • - Each stage builds upon the previous, cultivating deeper awareness and unity
  • - Together, they form the meditative path (Samyama) leading to Self-realization.
questions.final_answer: Option Dharana
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the steps to perform Utkatasana and mention its precautions.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans : Steps to perform Utkatasana
  • Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
  • Inhale, raise arms overhead, parallel to each other.
  • Exhale, bend knees, lower hips as if sitting back.
  • Keep back straight, engage core, gaze forward.
  • Hold, breathe deeply, then release.
  • - Precautions
  • Avoid if you have knee or hip injuries, or chronic back pain.
  • Modify or avoid if you have low blood pressure or dizziness.
  • Engage core, keep back straight to prevent strain.
  • Don't hold breath, breathe naturally or as instructed.
  • Listen to your body, come out of pose if discomfort arises.
questions.final_answer: Listen to your body, come out of pose if discomfort arises
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the steps to perform Utkatasana and mention its precautions.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans : Steps to perform Utkatasana
  • Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
  • Inhale, raise arms overhead, parallel to each other.
  • Exhale, bend knees, lower hips as if sitting back.
  • Keep back straight, engage core, gaze forward.
  • Hold, breathe deeply, then release.
  • - Precautions
  • Avoid if you have knee or hip injuries, or chronic back pain.
  • Modify or avoid if you have low blood pressure or dizziness.
  • Engage core, keep back straight to prevent strain.
  • Don't hold breath, breathe naturally or as instructed.
  • Listen to your body, come out of pose if discomfort arises.
questions.final_answer: Listen to your body, come out of pose if discomfort arises
